record_sets.query: SELECT `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources`.uuid_hash_value(p.person_id) AS donor_id, 'Human' AS organism_type, `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources`.uuid_hash_value('$DATASET_NAME') AS part_of_dataset_id, COALESCE(v1.mapped_value, c1.concept_name, CAST(p.gender_source_value AS STRING)) AS phenotypic_sex, CASE WHEN COALESCE(v2.mapped_value, c2.concept_name, CAST(p.ethnicity_source_value AS STRING)) IS NOT NULL THEN [COALESCE(v2.mapped_value, c2.concept_name, CAST(p.ethnicity_source_value AS STRING))] ELSE [] END AS reported_ethnicity, ['person:'||p.datarepo_row_id] AS source_datarepo_row_ids FROM `$BQ_DATASET.person` p LEFT JOIN `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources.concept` c1 ON p.gender_concept_id = c1.concept_id LEFT JOIN `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources.vocab_map` v1 ON c1.concept_name = v1.source_value AND v1.attribute = 'phenotypic_sex' LEFT JOIN `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources.concept` c2 ON p.ethnicity_concept_id = c2.concept_id LEFT JOIN `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources.vocab_map` v2 ON c2.concept_name = v2.source_value AND v2.attribute = 'reported_ethnicity' WHERE 1=1
record_sets.mapping_eval_query: SELECT 'phenotypic_sex' AS attribute, COALESCE(c1.concept_name, CAST(p.gender_source_value AS STRING)) AS source_value, v1.mapped_value AS mapped_value, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM `$BQ_DATASET.person` p LEFT JOIN `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources.concept` c1 ON p.gender_concept_id = c1.concept_id LEFT JOIN `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources.vocab_map` v1 ON c1.concept_name = v1.source_value AND v1.attribute = 'phenotypic_sex' GROUP BY COALESCE(c1.concept_name, CAST(p.gender_source_value AS STRING)), v1.mapped_value UNION ALL SELECT 'reported_ethnicity' AS attribute, COALESCE(c1.concept_name, CAST(p.ethnicity_source_value AS STRING)) AS source_value, v1.mapped_value AS mapped_value, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM `$BQ_DATASET.person` p LEFT JOIN `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources.concept` c1 ON p.ethnicity_concept_id = c1.concept_id LEFT JOIN `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources.vocab_map` v1 ON c1.concept_name = v1.source_value AND v1.attribute = 'reported_ethnicity' GROUP BY COALESCE(c1.concept_name, CAST(p.ethnicity_source_value AS STRING)), v1.mapped_value

record_sets.mapping_eval_query: SELECT 'disease' AS attribute, COALESCE(c1.concept_name, CAST(c.condition_source_value AS STRING)) AS source_value, v1.mapped_value AS mapped_value, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM `$BQ_DATASET.condition_occurrence` c LEFT JOIN `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources.concept` c1 ON c.condition_concept_id = c1.concept_id LEFT JOIN `dsp-data-ingest.transform_resources.vocab_map` v1 ON c1.concept_name = v1.source_value AND v1.attribute = 'disease' GROUP BY COALESCE(c1.concept_name, CAST(c.condition_source_value AS STRING)), v1.mapped_value
